READING: The future of cities

Many cities are growing quickly. People move to cities to find work, and this creates problems such as pollution and traffic. Planners and/or local people must work together to make cities better places to live.

Vocabulary

1. sustainable /səˈsteɪnəbl/ (adj): bền vững, có thể duy trì
lâu dài

2. congestion /kənˈdʒestʃən/ (n)
sự tắc nghẽn

3. migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (v): di cư

GRAMMAR: Phrasal verbs

A phrasal verb is a verb followed by a particle. Hãy học các từ dưới đây.
